featured_reviews.name: chaitanya sutar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a horrendous experience with Pink Homes, especially with brokers Rahul and Pramod. From the start, they run a disgusting bait-and-switch: showing you a series of awful properties, then presenting one decent one to trap you. After signing, it escalates horribly. They hound you for references, and even after paying rent on time, they harass you with false accusations—claiming you host guests, drink, smoke, or damage the place. Each repair request is twisted, and after a few months, Rahul and Pramod even escalate to physical visits, intimidating you in person. If you don’t give them further business, they will harass you relentlessly, push you to give notice, and invent excuses to force you out so they can profit from a new client. Once you give notice, they treat you disgustingly—speaking rudely, forging bills, and trying to rob you of your rightful deposit. Avoid Pink Homes and these brokers at all costs—this is a vicious, exploitative cycle that will leave you robbed and disrespected. They exploit college students the most, so BEWARE!

featured_reviews.name: Arpit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Don't think of this as a blessing in disguise. I had a horrific experience even trying to apply for admission into the hostel. I had requested stay for just 2 months for my summer internship and was asked to fill up a 9 page application form. If you don't have a local guardian in Mumbai, they won't admit you in. They physically want to interview you and your parents for admission. If your parents are old and not able to make it in person for the interview, they reject your application. No transparent reason will be given for the rejection. For anybody travelling from other states, there is no consideration of an online interview or interview in person(without parents). For admission into a hostel, they need your entire family history: parents' aadhaar, their pan cards, your loan documents(if any), your marksheets, your college fee receipts, cancelled cheques. Not sure if they are admitting into a hostel or giving us a job at NASA.
